svg.aria-label: SyncYourPods — Your PC's sound on your AirPods, through your iPhone (open source, MIT)
svg.title: SyncYourPods — Your PC's sound on your AirPods, through your iPhone (open source, MIT)

g.text: Your PC's sound on your AirPods,
AirPods hop between your phone and your PC
by themselves. The PC streams raw audio over
Wi-Fi in 3 ms packets, and the phone plays it,
stepping aside whenever something else starts.
